 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Coach Derek Mason and Middle Tennessee State football are looking to finish the season with consecutive wins.
 The Blue Raiders would clinch a bowl berth with a win against Sam Houston in Huntsville, Texas, on Nov. 21 (1 p.m. CT, ESPN+ ).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement MTSU (5-5, 3-3 Conference USA) is coming off a 28-23 loss at Liberty , while Sam Houston (1-9, 0-6) suffered a loss to Kennesaw State, 26-7.
 Follow below for live updates throughout the game, including scores, predictions and odds and the Blue Raiders' schedule:
